ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the “Ashima landscape” on the left side of the figure is a group of towering stone pillars; its form is not like an ordinary mountain body, but has obvious human pictographic characteristics, easily making people think of the legendary Yi girl “Ashima”. The schematic diagram on the right shows the formation and distribution background of the stone forest landform. Then reason: the stem asks, when appreciating this landscape, “what of the landscape should be grasped emphatically”; because the most prominent value of this landscape lies in the unique human-shaped appearance and pictographic characteristics of the stone pillars, it should therefore be summarized as grasping or seizing the landscape characteristics.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中“阿诗玛”石柱的形态：它不是普通山体，而是具有鲜明人物象形特征的石林景观。再结合题干问“应重点把握景观的什么”，把“人物状石柱的独特形态”概括为景观特色，作答“抓住景观特色”。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中左侧的“阿诗玛景观”是一组高耸的石柱，形态不像普通山体，而是具有明显的人物象形特征，容易让人联想到传说中的彝族姑娘“阿诗玛”。右侧示意图表现的是石林地貌的形成与分布背景。再推理：题干问欣赏该景观时“应重点把握景观的什么”，由于该景观最突出的价值在于石柱独特的人物状外形和象形特征，因此应概括为把握或抓住景观特色。
